title: Prohibition of fishing in maritime zones of India by foreign vessels.
text:
Subject to the provisions of this Act, no foreign vessel shall, except under and in accordance with--

(a) a licence granted under section 4; or

(b) a permit granted under section 5,

by the Central Government, be used for fishing within any maritime zone of India.
conditions: Subject to the provisions of this Act.
The foreign vessel must operate under and in accordance with a licence granted under section 4 or a permit granted under section 5 by the Central Government.
source: India Code, Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
